module.purpose: Builds a Redux middleware internal handler that refetches RTK queries when window focus or online events occur, based on subscriptions and config.
module.summary: This module exports a builder that constructs an internal middleware handler for RTK Query. The handler intercepts focus and online actions and triggers a batched scan of active query subscriptions. For each subscription, it decides whether to refetch the query or remove it based on per-subscription flags or global reducer configuration. It encapsulates the window-event-to-query-refetch logic used to keep cached data fresh.
module.businessContext: Ensures web app data stays fresh by refetching on focus/reconnect. Failure causes stale UI data after backgrounding or offline use.
functions: buildWindowEventHandler (~L10-64): Builder returning middleware handler for window events
refetchValidQueries (~L28-61): Iterates subscriptions to refetch or remove queries
